description: Submit a canonical proposal to duplicate a source Meta ad with a different creative asset. Approved copies are always created PAUSED.

account_id.description: Advertising account ID. Required when the workspace has more than one active account.

asset_id.description: Asset ID returned by upload-asset or get-creative-library.

idempotency_key.description: Stable key reused when retrying this duplicate proposal.

name_suffix.description: Optional suffix for the copied ad name.

rationale.description: Why this new creative variant should be created.

source_ad.description: Numeric Meta ID of the ad to duplicate.

name: duplicate-ad-with-creative
title: Duplicate Ad With Creative
